title: Deep-hole gun drilling of pressure housings
description: Deep-hole gun drilling of pressure housings capability for titanium components
processDescription: Laser drilling of titanium uses pulsed laser energy to create precise holes through percussion or trepanning methods. Hole diameters range from 0.05 mm to 3 mm with aspect ratios up to 20:1, specifically for housing. Deep housing for Aerospace, Marine present unique challenges: Thin-wall cylindrical sections (1.5–4 mm) with multiple mounting bosses require stress-relieved cast/wrought stock and sequenced roughing to prevent distortion.
heatControl: Pulsed fiber laser with nitrogen assist gas. Pulse energy and frequency controlled to minimize recast layer.
flatnessControl: Non-contact process; no mechanical distortion. Vacuum fixturing for thin foil.
capabilitiesDescription: Integrated manufacturing capability for Deep-hole gun drilling of pressure housings, supported by in-house QC, material certification, and engineering review.
